import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_ports(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0065535"), 65535)

    def test_surrounding_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80 "), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   443   "), 443)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("8080")), int)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("00000")

    def test_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("99999")
        self.assertRejects("0065536")

    def test_empty_and_space_only(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("     ")

    def test_signs(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-1")
        self.assertRejects("- 80")
        self.assertRejects("+ 80")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejects("\v80")
        self.assertRejects("\f80")

    def test_non_space_whitespace(self):
        self.assertRejects(" 80")
        self.assertRejects("80　")

    def test_non_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth "80"
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic "80"
        self.assertRejects("¹8")  # superscript one followed by 8

    def test_decimal_points_and_exponents(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".5")
        self.assertRejects("80.")
        self.assertRejects("1e3")

    def test_other_notations(self):
        self.assertRejects("0x50")
        self.assertRejects("1_000")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")
        self.assertRejects("80 80")

    def test_non_string_inputs(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(True)
        self.assertRejects([80])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import parse_port


class ParsePortValidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lower_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("1"), 1)

    def test_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535"), 65535)

    def test_common_ports(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("80"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("443"), 443)

    def test_returns_int(self):
        self.assertIs(type(parse_port("8080")), int)

    def test_surrounding_spaces(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port(" 8080 "), 8080)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("   1"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("65535   "), 65535)

    def test_leading_zeros(self):
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0080"), 80)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("00001"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("000065535"), 65535)
        self.assertEqual(parse_port("0" * 1000 + "22"), 22)


class ParsePortInvalidTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assertRejects(self, value):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            parse_port(value)

    def test_zero_is_out_of_range(self):
        self.assertRejects("0")
        self.assertRejects("00000")

    def test_just_above_upper_boundary(self):
        self.assertRejects("65536")
        self.assertRejects("099999")
        self.assertRejects("100000")

    def test_large_values(self):
        self.assertRejects("999999999999999999999999")
        self.assertRejects("9" * 5000)

    def test_empty_and_space_only(self):
        self.assertRejects("")
        self.assertRejects(" ")
        self.assertRejects("   ")

    def test_signs(self):
        self.assertRejects("+80")
        self.assertRejects("-1")
        self.assertRejects(" -80 ")

    def test_tabs_and_newlines(self):
        self.assertRejects("\t80")
        self.assertRejects("80\t")
        self.assertRejects("80\n")
        self.assertRejects("\n80")
        self.assertRejects("80\r\n")
        self.assertRejects("8 0")

    def test_decimal_points_and_exponents(self):
        self.assertRejects("80.0")
        self.assertRejects(".80")
        self.assertRejects("8e1")

    def test_non_ascii_digits(self):
        self.assertRejects("٨٠")  # Arabic-Indic digits 8 0
        self.assertRejects("８０")  # fullwidth digits 8 0
        self.assertRejects("²")  # superscript two

    def test_non_string_inputs(self):
        self.assertRejects(None)
        self.assertRejects(80)
        self.assertRejects(80.0)
        self.assertRejects(b"80")
        self.assertRejects(["80"])

    def test_non_numeric_text(self):
        self.assertRejects("http")
        self.assertRejects("80a")
        self.assertRejects("0x50")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import topological_order  # noqa: E402


class TopologicalOrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_valid(self, order, nodes, edges):
        self.assertEqual(sorted(order), sorted(nodes))
        self.assertEqual(len(order), len(nodes))
        position = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(order)}
        for before, after in edges:
            self.assertLess(position[before], position[after])

    def test_empty_graph(self):
        self.assertEqual(topological_order([], []), [])

    def test_isolated_nodes_are_all_returned(self):
        nodes = ["x", "y", "z"]
        order = topological_order(nodes, [])
        self.assert_valid(order, nodes, [])

    def test_chain_has_single_valid_order(self):
        nodes = ["c", "a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        self.assertEqual(topological_order(nodes, edges), ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_diamond(self):
        nodes = ["d", "c", "b", "a"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "c"), ("b", "d"), ("c", "d")]
        self.assert_valid(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_disconnected_components_with_isolated_node(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]
        edges = [("b", "a"), ("d", "c")]
        self.assert_valid(topological_order(nodes, edges), nodes, edges)

    def test_duplicate_edges_do_not_create_false_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(order, ["a", "b", "c"])

    def test_two_node_cycle_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_longer_cycle_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c"), ("c", "d"), ("d", "b")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)

    def test_cycle_with_isolated_nodes_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "free"]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(["a"], [("a", "a")])

    def test_self_loop_alongside_valid_edges_raises(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, [("a", "b"), ("b", "b")])

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b", "c"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
        nodes_copy = list(nodes)
        edges_copy = list(edges)
        topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, nodes_copy)
        self.assertEqual(edges, edges_copy)

    def test_inputs_are_not_mutated_on_cycle(self):
        nodes = ["a", "b"]
        edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assertEqual(nodes, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertEqual(edges, [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])

    def test_larger_graph(self):
        nodes = [f"n{i}" for i in range(200)]
        edges = [(f"n{i}", f"n{i + 1}") for i in range(199)]
        edges += [("n0", "n100"), ("n50", "n150")] * 3
        order = topological_order(nodes, edges)
        self.assert_valid(order, nodes, edges)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        rows = [
            (1, "100% pure"),
            (2, "100 pure"),
            (3, "a_c"),
            (4, "abc"),
            (5, "a\\b"),
            (6, "ab"),
            (7, "bob"),
            (8, "bob"),
            (9, "alice"),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def names(self, prefix, limit=100):
        return [name for _, name in search(self.conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("100%"), ["100% pure"])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("a_"), ["a_c"])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("a\\"), ["a\\b"])

    def test_sql_injection_attempt_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.names("x' OR '1'='1"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names("' OR 1=1 --"), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 9)

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_names(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(self.names("")), 9)

    def test_results_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            search(self.conn, "b", 100),
            [(7, "bob"), (8, "bob"), (6, "ab")][::-1][::-1][1:2] and
            [(7, "bob"), (8, "bob")],
        )

    def test_ties_broken_by_id(self):
        self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO users VALUES (0, 'bob')")
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "bob", 100)[0], (0, "bob"))
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "bob", 100)[1:], [(7, "bob"), (8, "bob")])

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_hundred_is_clamped(self):
        self.conn.executemany(
            "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
            [(i, f"user{i:03d}") for i in range(100, 250)],
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "user", 500)), 100)

    def test_limit_within_range_is_respected(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 3)), 3)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_non_integer_limit_rejected(self):
        for bad in (2.0, "5", None, [5]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_conn(rows):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_percent_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "50% off"), (2, "5000"), (3, "50 off")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "50%", 10), [(1, "50% off")])

    def test_underscore_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a_c"), (2, "abc"), (3, "ab")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_c")])

    def test_backslash_in_prefix_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a\\"), (2, "a\\b"), (3, "ax")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\"), (2, "a\\b")])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "b"), (2, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(2, "a"), (1, "b")])

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_conn([(3, "bob"), (1, "bob"), (2, "al")])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "", 10), [(2, "al"), (1, "bob"), (3, "bob")]
        )

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_of_one(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a"), (2, "b")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 0), [(1, "a")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", -5), [(1, "a")])

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_of_100(self):
        conn = make_conn([(i, "n%03d" % i) for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 1000)), 100)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_int_limit(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a")])
        for bad in ("5", 5.0, None):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_str_prefix(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "a")])
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, None, 10)
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(conn, 5, 10)

    def test_sql_injection_payload_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_conn([(1, "alice"), (2, "bob")])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "' OR '1'='1", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "x' OR 1=1 --", 10), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(conn.execute("SELECT * FROM users").fetchall()), 2)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


def make_db(names):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT INTO users VALUES (?, ?)",
        [(i, name) for i, name in enumerate(names, start=1)],
    )
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def names(self, conn, prefix, limit=100):
        return [name for _, name in search(conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_plain_prefix_matches(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "albert", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "al"), ["albert", "alice"])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["100%off", "100 off", "1000"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "100%"), ["100%off"])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a_b", "axb", "ab"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a_"), ["a_b"])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\b", "ab", "a\\"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a\\"), ["a\\", "a\\b"])

    def test_backslash_before_wildcard_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db(["a\\%x", "a%x", "axx"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "a\\%"), ["a\\%x"])

    def test_sql_injection_prefix_is_inert(self):
        conn = make_db(["alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "' OR '1'='1"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "x' OR 1=1 --"), [])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all(self):
        conn = make_db(["bob", "alice"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, ""), ["alice", "bob"])

    def test_ties_sorted_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db(["zed", "amy", "amy", "amy"])
        self.assertEqual(
            search(conn, "a", 100),
            [(2, "amy"), (3, "amy"), (4, "amy")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 2), [(2, "amy"), (3, "amy")])

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        conn = make_db([f"user{i:03d}" for i in range(20)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 5)), 5)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum_one(self):
        conn = make_db(["a", "b", "c"])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "", -50)), 1)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum_100(self):
        conn = make_db([f"u{i:03d}" for i in range(150)])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "u", 500)), 100)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "u", 100)), 100)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(conn, "", False)

    def test_non_integer_limit_rejected(self):
        conn = make_db(["a"])
        for bad in (1.0, "5", None, [1]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(conn, "", bad)

    def test_matching_is_case_insensitive_for_ascii_like_sqlite(self):
        conn = make_db(["Alice", "bob"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(conn, "al"), ["Alice"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "src"))

from solution import search  # noqa: E402


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
        self.conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
        rows = [
            (1, "alice"),
            (2, "alfred"),
            (3, "bob"),
            (4, "al%ice"),
            (5, "al_ice"),
            (6, "al\\ice"),
            (7, "ALBERT"),
            (8, "alice"),
            (9, "x'; DROP TABLE users; --"),
            (10, "aXb"),
            (11, "a_b"),
        ]
        self.conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def ids(self, prefix, limit=100):
        return [row[0] for row in search(self.conn, prefix, limit)]

    def test_basic_prefix_match(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("bo"), [3])

    def test_empty_prefix_matches_all_up_to_limit(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 100)), 11)

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("%"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("al%"), [4])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("_"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("a_"), [11])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("al_"), [5])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("\\"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("al\\"), [6])

    def test_escape_sequence_in_prefix_is_not_special(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("al\\%"), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("\\%"), [])

    def test_quote_injection_is_inert(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("x'; DROP TABLE users; --"), [9])
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "' OR '1'='1", 100)), 0)
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 11)

    def test_ordering_is_name_then_id(self):
        self.conn.execute("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (0, 'alice')")
        rows = search(self.conn, "alice", 100)
        self.assertEqual(rows, [(0, "alice"), (8, "alice")])

    def test_limit_applies_after_sort(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.ids("al", 2), [5, 1])

    def test_limit_below_one_is_clamped_to_one(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_limit_above_hundred_is_clamped_to_hundred(self):
        for i in range(200):
            self.conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", (1000 + i, f"bulk{i:03d}")
            )
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 1000)), 100)

    def test_bool_limit_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "a", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "a", False)

    def test_non_integer_limit_rejected(self):
        for bad in (1.0, "10", None, [10]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "a", bad)

    def test_non_string_prefix_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "src"))

from solution import search


def make_db(rows):
    conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER, name TEXT)")
    conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name) VALUES (?, ?)", rows)
    return conn


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.conn = make_db([
            (1, "alice"),
            (2, "alicia"),
            (3, "bob"),
        ])

    def tearDown(self):
        self.conn.close()

    def test_prefix_match(self):
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, "ali", 10), [(1, "alice"), (2, "alicia")])

    def test_percent_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db([(1, "100%"), (2, "100 apples"), (3, "1000")])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "100%", 10), [(1, "100%")])

    def test_underscore_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db([(1, "a_b"), (2, "axb"), (3, "a_bc")])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a_", 10), [(1, "a_b"), (3, "a_bc")])

    def test_backslash_is_literal(self):
        conn = make_db([(1, "a\\b"), (2, "a%b"), (3, "ab")])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "a\\", 10), [(1, "a\\b")])

    def test_injection_attempt_is_treated_as_text(self):
        payload = "x' OR '1'='1"
        self.assertEqual(search(self.conn, payload, 10), [])
        count = self.conn.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users").fetchone()[0]
        self.assertEqual(count, 3)

    def test_orders_by_name_then_id(self):
        conn = make_db([(5, "sam"), (2, "sam"), (9, "al")])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(search(conn, "", 10), [(9, "al"), (2, "sam"), (5, "sam")])

    def test_limit_is_applied(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 2)), 2)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_maximum(self):
        conn = make_db([(i, f"user{i:03d}") for i in range(150)])
        self.addCleanup(conn.close)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(conn, "user", 1000)), 100)

    def test_limit_clamped_to_minimum(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", 0)), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(search(self.conn, "", -5)), 1)

    def test_rejects_bool_limit(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", True)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            search(self.conn, "", False)

    def test_rejects_non_integer_limit(self):
        for bad in (2.0, "5", None, [1]):
            with self.subTest(limit=bad):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    search(self.conn, "", bad)

    def test_rejects_non_string_prefix(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            search(self.conn, None, 10)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

from typing import Iterable


def decode_chunks(chunks: Iterable[bytes]) -> str:
    decoder = codecs.getincrementaldecoder("utf-8")(errors="strict")
    parts = [decoder.decode(chunk) for chunk in chunks]
    parts.append(decoder.decode(b"", final=True))
    return "".join(parts)

import os
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "src"))

from solution import resolve_upload


class ResolveUploadTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        tmp_dir = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(tmp_dir.cleanup)
        tmp = Path(tmp_dir.name).resolve()
        self.root = tmp / "root"
        self.sibling = tmp / "root-sibling"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_nested_nonexistent_path_is_allowed_and_not_created(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/new.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "new.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_existing_file_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "f.txt").write_text("x")
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "f.txt"), self.root / "f.txt")

    def test_dot_dot_that_stays_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a/../b.txt"), self.root / "b.txt")

    def test_absolute_paths_are_rejected(self):
        for supplied in [str(self.sibling / "secret.txt"), "/etc/passwd"]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_root_itself_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in ["", ".", "a/.."]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_traversal_outside_root_is_rejected(self):
        for supplied in [
            "../root-sibling/secret.txt",
            "a/../../root-sibling/secret.txt",
            "../outside.txt",
        ]:
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_file_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "link.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "link.txt")

    def test_directory_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "dirlink")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dirlink")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dirlink/new.txt")

    def test_dangling_symlink_pointing_outside_is_rejected(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "missing.txt", self.root / "dangling")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "dangling")

    def test_symlink_pointing_inside_root_is_allowed(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()
        os.symlink(self.root / "real", self.root / "alias")
        self.assertEqual(
            resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/new.txt"),
            self.root / "real" / "new.txt",
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

    def setUp(self):

        self.addCleanup(tmp.cleanup)
        base = Path(tmp.name).resolve()
        self.root = base / "root"
        self.root.mkdir()
        self.sibling = base / "root_sibling"
        self.sibling.mkdir()
        (self.sibling / "secret.txt").write_text("secret")

    def test_accepts_simple_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(resolve_upload(self.root, "a.txt"), self.root / "a.txt")

    def test_accepts_nested_nonexistent_path_without_creating_it(self):
        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "a/b/c.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "a" / "b" / "c.txt")
        self.assertFalse((self.root / "a").exists())

    def test_rejects_absolute_paths(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, str(self.root / "x.txt"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "/etc/passwd")

    def test_rejects_root_itself(self):
        for supplied in (".", "", "a/..", "a/../"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_traversal_into_sibling(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root_sibling/new.txt")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../root_sibling/secret.txt")

    def test_rejects_traversal_above_base(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "../../../etc/passwd")

    def test_rejects_symlinked_directory_pointing_outside(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling, self.root / "abs_link")
        os.symlink("../root_sibling", self.root / "rel_link")
        for supplied in ("abs_link", "abs_link/new.txt", "rel_link/new.txt"):
            with self.subTest(supplied=supplied):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    resolve_upload(self.root, supplied)

    def test_rejects_symlinked_file_pointing_outside(self):
        os.symlink(self.sibling / "secret.txt", self.root / "file_link")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "file_link")

    def test_accepts_symlink_pointing_inside_root(self):
        (self.root / "real").mkdir()

        result = resolve_upload(self.root, "alias/x.txt")
        self.assertEqual(result, self.root / "real" / "x.txt")

    def test_rejects_symlink_loop(self):
        os.symlink(self.root / "loop2", self.root / "loop1")
        os.symlink(self.root / "loop1", self.root / "loop2")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            resolve_upload(self.root, "loop1")

from pathlib import Path, PurePath


def resolve_upload(root, supplied):
    """Validate an untrusted relative path against root without touching the filesystem.

    This is a lexical and symlink-aware check only; a later open must still guard against races.
    """
    base = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
    relative = PurePath(supplied)
    if relative.anchor:
        raise ValueError("absolute paths are not allowed")
    target = (base / relative).resolve()
    if target == base:
        raise ValueError("target must not be the root directory")
    if not target.is_relative_to(base):
        raise ValueError("path escapes root directory")
    return target
